name: Easy Golf: Course Architect
summary: Easy Golf: Course Architect is a golf game which uses the traditional three-click system. With a button press, a bar starts filling up which is stopped by a second press; this sets the power of the hit. Then the bar starts filling up again and the third press sets how straight the shot will be. This depends on the bar's final position (left, center or right) in the designated hit zone. Stopping the bar outside of this zone will result in a bad shot. Additionally the player has multiple clubs to use and the wind to account for. The player character is a robot which can be customized with accessories (most of them have to be unlocked first).
